integrity: Proof-based same-model review with independently implemented finite face, fixed-orbit, and quotient-chain checks; finite checks do not certify unbounded results. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equivariant spherical model applies to t>=3 and n>=2t, with cyclic lens identification only for free rotation actions; the full dihedral three-sphere quotient is proved only for t=3. Integral homology for nonfree rotation quotients and smooth or PL conjugacy are not asserted. The earlier orientation-character and rational quotient results are explicitly prior art.
title: Dihedral fixed spaces, lens quotients, and sphere quotients of cyclic nonmatching complexes
